body.input:
REVIEW TEXT First off...I was greeted very rude. No smiles just a "What do you want"
Not hoe can I help you, not do you know what you'd like sir? Just a rude welcoming that made me want to walk out immediately. Sorry to inconvenience you with my business, secondly I almost walked out when I saw the prices for a simple club sub. 16.99 for a foot long sub. I could go eat a meal in a resteraunt, sit down be greeted with kindness and be much more worth the price, I could have gone next door and ate more food then I could handle for 11 dollars but they were closed and I was hungry. So..I got a 6" for 12 dollars that was actually more like a 4" because I think this very rude, entitled acting little boy cut it to short.
Look at my reviews and you'll see I don't give out one star ratings for no reason. It's very rare. Anyhow I would avoid this place at all costs. I hope they go out of business because in this little town the word is spreading, I'm not the only one with this experience.

REVIEW TEXT Great food, great atmosphere, great manager. Best experience I’ve ever had in a Domino’s and I’ve had a lot of experiences in  Domino’s. If you want pizza with local ingredients and local chefs, this is a spot you should go. The general manager is the nicest person I’ve ever talked to.

I agree. They deserve it.

body.input: REVIEW TEXT I don't like leaving bad reviews, but I felt compelled after my recent visit! We waited 35 minutes for a small pepperoni pizza and an order of spaghetti with meatballs! The meatballs were crunchy outside and kind of dry, they also absorbed all the acidic flavor from the tomato sauce and tasted off. The pasta was cheap and broke unevenly, it didn't absorb the bland sauce at all. They put the pepperoni underneath the cheese on the pizza and it was extremely greasy. It repelled the ranch dressing I dipped it in. The cheese was also low quality and was very spongy and stretchy. The crust was good, surprisingly enough. The staff were not very welcoming and the man who brought us our food seemed like he was having a rough day. I love supporting local businesses, but I can't see myself going back here. Save your money!!!

body.input: REVIEW TEXT This place is awesome!! This bowling alley was open when I was younger and then was shut down for years. All 3 of my boys (my young men) and my son's gf went bowling and we had a blast!! Prices are very reasonable (which is HUGE right now) and they have a teen bowling night on Tuesday nights for a discounted price. There is a bar, I know my oldest son and his gf were having a couple of beers, I am not sure if it's just beer or if they have mixed drinks as well but I will definitely check and update this if need be. We didn't keep score because I didn't want my boys to feel bad or get embarrassed when mommy won. I'm totally joking, I got my you know what handed to me, both games. They also have music and the owners allowed us to connect to the big Bluetooth speaker and we got to play whatever we wanted. It was so much fun though and I'm super stoked about going back to bowl (after I stretch and practice and probably stretch some more). I highly recommend checking it out. Oh and I almost forgot, they have a little restaurant connected to the bowling alley as well. We were there pretty late and the owners actually did us another favor (aside from allowing us to pick the music) and let us stay after closing as our game wasn't over and we're very grateful for that.

REVIEW TEXT I’ve been a regular customer for years at Diedrich Espresso and have always appreciated the baristas who make the experience welcoming. Recently, though, I’ve been really disappointed in how the management seems to handle their staff.

Even without going into details, I think it’s important to say this: how a business treats its employees directly impacts its customers. Baristas are the face of the shop, they’re the people we interact with every day. They’re the first faces we see in the morning, and their energy and consistency are what keep customers coming back. When management doesn’t value or support them, it affects the entire atmosphere. Losing good ones without professional transparency or acknowledgment changes the atmosphere significantly.

What feels especially frustrating is seeing the lack of any real response to customer concerns. It comes across as dismissive rather than addressing the issue professionally.

I truly believe in supporting local business, but part of that is expecting fair and respectful treatment of the workers who keep the place running. I hope the management takes this feedback seriously and prioritizes communication, respect, and accountability going forward.

body.input: REVIEW TEXT I usually stick to my regular espresso stand but I stopped here since it was closer. I ordered my daily coffee, a 16oz quad shot white chocolate caramel mocha iced no whip extra sweet. When I received it, it had whip cream (no big deal) I just asked if they could take it off. Once down the road I took a drink and I almost spit it out, I’ve had burnt espresso before but this was so much worse like it was an old espresso that was saved and burnt. I never complain about anything but I had to. I went back I let her know that it was pretty bitter and tasted burnt, and said she would remake it. She stated that their coffee is normally bitter (really!?) and would I like it to be a 24oz vs 16oz to which I replied yes. It took her less than 2 minutes to “remake” the drink and it tasted almost as bad as the first, just watered down due to the new size. I knew she didn’t remake the drink at all, just poured it into the larger cup, added more milk and flavor to dilute bitter/burnt espresso. Just to get it over with and since at that point I could tell that she was annoyed I told her it was the coffee was fine. I drove out of my way to go to my usual espresso stand to get a new coffee and throw that one away. I will never go back to that stand or any other Diedrich stand for that matter, that’s pure laziness and terrible customer service. Waste of time and money…

REVIEW TEXT My Wife and I love Anacortes and thought we'd try this place as it gets a 4.7 rating.
So we stop for Lunch.
Not busy and we got our order in...General Tsaos Chicken and Kung Pao Chicken.
First off...we Come to Anacortes for the Food and...we were GREATLY disappointed  😞
All I can say is...we can get better food at Panda Express!!!
Both dishes were just okay...nothing special.
The Broccoli that was included with the General Tsao's was Luke warm and not even cooked with the Chicken.
The same with the Peanuts on the Kung Pao...Just thrown on top!!
Prices were good but quality of the Dishes wasn't worth stopping for!!
A disappointing visit to the town of Anacortes!
I don't know how they get such a good rating?
Maybe people are ok with mediocre food?
Won't be going here again!!
It's like the Chef gave up and lost their passion for cooking!!!
Rather sad in a town full of GOOD restaurants  😕

body.input:
REVIEW TEXT Dear Calico Cupboard Management,
I am writing as a longtime and loyal customer of The Calico Cupboard. Over the years, I have visited all three locations and have consistently had wonderful experiences at both the Anacortes and La Conner restaurants. Because of that history, I felt confident recommending Calico Cupboard to my family and fiancé.
Yesterday, I visited the Mt. Vernon location for the first time in roughly ten years to pick up treats for my family, and unfortunately the experience was deeply disappointing.
The restaurant felt chaotic, understaffed, and poorly organized. I have over 20 years of experience in the restaurant and service industry, and it was very apparent that the staff was overwhelmed, disengaged, and not working as a team. Servers appeared lost, customers were visibly frustrated, and there was little sense of leadership or coordination on the floor. The overall atmosphere reflected exhaustion and low morale rather than pride in the business.
We purchased two cinnamon rolls, two snickerdoodles, and one gingerbread man, for a total of approximately $40. The employee who assisted us was short and unpleasant in tone, and our items were packaged with little care. This was especially frustrating as I had spoken very highly of Calico Cupboard beforehand—my fiancé left with a very poor impression.
When we arrived home, the disappointment continued. The cinnamon rolls were dry, crumbly, and tasted stale, with frosting that was crusted over. Overall, the baked goods felt old and far below the quality I have always associated with your bakery. This is in stark contrast to the La Conner location, where staff consistently take extra care with guests and with packaging items meant to be taken home.
Given the service, presentation, and quality of the food, I am requesting a full refund for this purchase.
I am not writing to bash your business. I am writing because Calico Cupboard has been a favorite of mine for years, and it was genuinely upsetting to see one location fall so far below the standard set by the others. Mt. Vernon would benefit greatly from stronger leadership, clearer teamwork expectations, and staff who genuinely care about representing your business and your vision.
I hope this feedback reaches an owner or decision-maker who can address these concerns and help bring the Mt. Vernon location back to the level of excellence your brand is known for.
Thank you for taking the time to read this. I look forward to your response.

Update:
Management did respond via email, however the response showed no accountability. My experience was dismissed entirely because the manager (*Norvel) stated he did not personally observe any issues that day. The quality concerns and service breakdown I described were denied. A $20 gift card was offered... however, my concern was never compensation, but brand standards and consistency. Unfortunately, the lack of openness to feedback was as disappointing as the original visit.

REVIEW TEXT We had an absolutely amazing experience for my birthday dinner out with my husband 🙂. Our server was so incredibly welcoming, wonderful, & extremely friendly. As always if you plan on eating at Olive🫒Garden, bring an empty stomach, Lolol 😄, as they DO NOT SKIMP on portions, Lolol 😄! All their food is hot, full of Italian flavors from the different regions in Italy they come from, & served with love on plates that are deliciously prepared & overflowing! You'll be taking some home🏡 for sure, Lolol 😄!

Also, try their reservation service they now have! Despite there being lots of people waiting, From the time we hit the text link that we'd arrived to before my husband could undo all the straps to secure my electric wheelchair, & I could get down the ramp of our van, we'd already been notified our table was ready! What a fantastic service!

body.input:
REVIEW TEXT I'll be honest: this place looks Sketchy in its tiny building along hwy 20.
But since it's still in business and we often see a line, we figured maybe it's a hidden gem. The hours are odd - it's been four years of assuming this place must be epicly good but being unable to try it because it was never open when we had a free afternoon. So after many years and lots of "oh, maybe next time... I really need to look up their schedule sometime," the stars aligned and we finally drove by at the right time.

This place has a tiny building and limited capacity to cook. Service is slower. They told us upfront it would be a 25-minute wait, and it was exactly that. We expected to wait and that was fine.

The price: $43 for two burgers, one order of onion rings, and one order of garlic fries. I think there were a couple of sides of sauce. There was a sign about an additional "inflation fee" or something similar by the order window. OK then, didn't really care for that tbh.

Twenty-five minutes in our car to ponder their inflation sign, the wait, and the price.

Can't help but be honest - There was a lot of "this must be good since people wait so long and pay this much." Expectations were high even though we were already a little disappointed.

The positives - the box the food comes in looked nice, felt heavy, quality presentation.
The garlic fries were great, actually they were absolutely phenomenal. Legitimately the best we've ever had!
Which is why its so confusing. The reviewers all say juicy, delicious burgers. The best ever. However,  the burger was a huge letdown. Fresh Lettuce and Tomato, which was nice, and seemed promising, burger looked delicious.
However, there's no convincing me the meat patty wasn't just an Extremely Over-Peppered, Frozen hockey puck straight from Costco or the Chef Store. I ate half, pulled the patty out, and literally knocked it against the table to show how solid it was. It was dryer than dry and the pepper was overwhelming. I can make the same thing at home faster, cheaper, and better. The onion rings were too oily and I wouldn't try those again.

I can't imagine waiting that long - or paying that much - for a burger like that again. But so many people do. We plan to come back just to see: was it an off day or not?
If the garlic fries could be that GOOD, I just know the burgers can be too. Everything about this place - from the campy, off hwy 20 vibe, to the nice gal that took our order, to the delightful presentation, screamed this is going to be the best burger of your life.
So for now: 3 stars for the garlic fries and nice gal at the window.

I sure hope I can change this to a 5 star in the future. I do believe it was an off day but I can't give a better review for a burger we could each only eat half of.

body.input:
REVIEW TEXT After an amazing experience at The Fork in Bellingham, I had this on my list to go to when I went south to see family. Unfortunately, it was not what we had hoped for.
First, the bad: The fries appeared to be cooked just in oil or something; they were not crispy at all and had almost no flavor besides oil and potato. That probably sounds a bit weird, but I've had a lot of fries in my life and these were among the worst. My wife's chicken sandwich was borderline inedible; greasy and tasteless. It was supposed to come with coleslaw, and there was hardly any. Our food also took quite a long time to come despite the two of us being the only people in the restaurant for the first 20 minutes or so.
On the positive side, our server was very friendly and my fish in the fish and chips was pretty good; a bit oily, but not bad. They do multiple fish "sticks" instead of big pieces. And the music playlist was excellent and really contributed to the nice ambiance of the restaurant.
The place really has potential so I hope they'll pick things up soon and make improvements.

REVIEW TEXT We have loved this place since we moved to A town two years ago. One of our frequent splurges is to get an order of lasagna to go. Nice meal for two smaller appetites.
But somewhere around December of 2024, something changed in this dishes' sauce. Where it once was a very lovely tomato sauce that made it just spectacular, now it has become a much smoother tomato and cream based sauce. It lost so much of its perfection with that change. And yes, we have tried it three more times to be sure it wasn't a one-off error.

EDIT 1/20/2026.
They contacted me personally about what changed and how to work around it. They said when you order it, order it without cream. So we have done that recently and every time it is back to its old lovely self!

We got the original lasagna back!!!!!!

REVIEW TEXT ✨ Apothecary Café is truly a gem in Sedro-Woolley. From the moment you walk in, you’re greeted by the friendliest staff who make you feel genuinely welcomed and cared for. The ambiance is incredibly serene—calm, cozy, and grounding—making it the perfect place to slow down and be present.
One of the best parts of the experience is enjoying your coffee while watching the sunrise glow over the mountains. The view adds such a peaceful, almost magical touch that makes every visit feel special.
The pastries are absolutely delicious, fresh, and beautifully made (you can taste the love in every bite). And the coffee? Next level. Their monthly flavor specials are always creative, perfectly balanced, and something I genuinely look forward to.
This is the kind of place that feeds both your soul and your senses. Highly recommend pairing a pastry with one of their specialty coffees—especially while soaking in the mountain views and a heart-shaped moment in your cup. 🤍✨

body.input: REVIEW TEXT This was our first time here. We sat at the bar and had a lovely interaction with the bartender, you could tell they were striving for good service. The restaurant was clean and aesthetically pleasing. Sadly, the food was not reciprocated. We started with an over dressed, soggy Caesar salad. I ordered my $47 NY strip medium rare, yet it was prepared medium well. I brought this to the server’s attention, prefacing that I didn’t want a new one as not to contribute to food waste. But, I do think it’s important for management/ownership to know of the mishap. At the very least, a comp’d glass of wine or dessert would have been a nice gesture, but no attempt was made. The sides to our entrees were extremely oily and didn’t match up to the prices we were paying. As a newer restaurant, there needs to be a bigger presence of management on the floor and not simply in these Google review responses.

body.input: REVIEW TEXT You might be tempted to think this place can't be significant with a small menu. But let me tell you, it's easy to decide what to get and the food is incredible. Not to mention if you bring small children, like me, you aren't roped into paying $16-20 for them to pick at most of the food and only eat a little. Pricing is beyond fair, with $4 being a lower cost item they offer. Sandwiches are super filling and under $12. The bread they use for the toasts will forever live in my mind, along with my spouse. We couldn't figure out how it was bread but melted in your mouth like butter. The owner was the front man and so kind. It's unheard of to visit a restaurant that discourages tips/heavily implying to tip on the menus and wall signs. But this place does just that. It shows the owner really cares for the craft above anything else, down to fresh ingredients and hand cut fries. I wish this place so much success and I plan on contributing to that by coming back more and telling friends. Thanks for a great meal with my family.

body.input:
REVIEW TEXT Recently, my family of six ordered dinner to go from the Hong Kong Chinese food restaurant located on Riverside Drive in Mount Vernon, Washington. Unfortunately, the experience was deeply disappointing and fell far below expectations for quality and taste.

From the outset, the food quality was noticeably poor. None of the dishes appeared to be freshly prepared; instead, they tasted as if they had been microwaved, lacking any homemade warmth or flavor. The meals were bland to the point of being almost inedible—so much so that I had to add salt from home just to make them palatable. The texture and taste reminded me of cardboard, lacking any distinct or authentic flavor profiles typically expected from Chinese cuisine.

Ironically, the only aspect of the meal that stood out positively was the quality of the to-go containers, which were sturdy and well-made. Beyond that, the food did not justify the cost paid. Given the price, I would have preferred to purchase Chinese food from a supermarket like Safeway, which, while not exceptional, would likely have been better than this experience.

This experience raises concerns not only about the food preparation but also about the value offered to customers. It felt as though the restaurant was not prioritizing genuine culinary quality or customer satisfaction. If you are considering ordering from this establishment, I would advise caution. The meal left a strong impression of being uninspired and lacking in care, which is disappointing for anyone seeking a satisfying and flavorful Chinese dining experience.

In summary, while the restaurant may continue to operate, the quality of the food served to my family was substandard and not worth the money spent. For those looking for authentic and enjoyable Chinese food in Mount Vernon, it may be best to explore other options.

body.input:
REVIEW TEXT Nonna Luisa Ristorante is, quite simply, the best Italian restaurant I have experienced in the area. From the moment you walk in, the authenticity is unmistakable. The ambience feels like a fast-paced Italian restaurant in New York City: lively, energetic, and full of character.

I have dined here five times, and every visit has been exceptional. Each time, I am treated like a regular, if not family, by who I can only assume is the owner...who always seats us in the "VIP" section, so he says. That level of personal attention is rare and speaks volumes about the pride and care behind this place.

On my very first visit, a few of the cooks broke into Italian arias while working in the kitchen. It was spontaneous, joyful, and unforgettable. In that moment, I knew this restaurant was something special.

If you are considering another Italian joint, fuhgeddaboudit! Go straight to Nonna Luisa Ristorante in Anacortes. You will not be disappointed.
Seriously, you need to hit that!

Al Torres
Friday Harbor, WA.

REVIEW TEXT While working on a project in La Conner, I kept catching these incredible aromas drifting through the air that made it impossible to focus. Naturally, I followed the smell, and it led me to a building right next door. The signage sits a bit high on the building, so it’s easy to miss, but once I opened the door I was immediately impressed.

Inside was a cool, retro diner atmosphere filled with people laughing, talking, and clearly enjoying themselves. The vibe alone made me glad I stopped in. I ordered the mushroom Swiss burger with fries, and it absolutely blew me away. The portions were very generous, and while the prices are a little on the higher side, they’re well worth it.

The burger was outstanding—fresh, crisp veggies, a thick and juicy patty that tasted fresh and locally sourced, and overall just really well put together. Everything felt high quality and made with care.

I’d recommend this place to anyone passing through or working in the area. I can’t wait to come back and try more items from the menu because if this burger was any indication, the rest of the food is going to be just as good

REVIEW TEXT My partner and I used to love coming to this restaurant for some cafe/diner style breakfast food. I remember the pricing was reasonable, portions were decently large, and the staff was always kind and attentive.

It had been awhile since we had eaten here, so a few weeks ago we decided to pick up a chicken fried steak to go. Like I said, portions used to be a decent size, so we thought we'd split it.

When we picked our food up, the one chicken friend steak was about $30. Is this price absurd? Yeah, for what the food is... it is. This felt like a steep increase in price, even compared to other local restaurants. When we got home, we opened our order. I had asked for gravy on the side, which showed us clear as day that our actual chicken fried steak was TINY. Like... the about the size of a regular tea bag (which we used as a "scale" for the photo we took).

The staff was still friendly. That's about the only positive thing I can say here. We wont be coming back.

body.input:
REVIEW TEXT I was there last Sunday in the evening anxious to eat there given the week before was fantastic, however, this time much of the food was warm rather than hot temp and some foods tasted fine while others were ok. But it was clear that the food was no where near as good as the last time. I was a bit disappointed.

I got home in Snohomish and about 30 minutes after being home I did a No. 2, then lots of liquid came out and then some diarrhea. It was clearly because of the buffet since I didn't have anything else after it. I took some Imodium to stop any further diarrhea and that worked, but was not feeling well,  was overly tired for a few days, just really wiped out. I did part of the BRAT diet eating rice and applesauce and bread and got better as my butt and tummy healed.

This buffet is good sometimes and other times not so much. They need to be more consistent in food quality and keep the food warmer and fresher. I took notice this time that the food had been sitting too long in their pans. The vegetables were wilted, the crawdads tail meat was grey - you can't eat it that way, some foods didn't taste quite right. Most seafood was fine tho. But something either in the food in general or that it wasn't hot or was old, or didn't get replaced more often had lessened the quality enough to get me sick. I realize trashing less than hot or lower quality food sitting too long is costly but without newer fresher food - this is part of the problem.

The buffet has value tho if you get a time there when all is great, but I would be watchful and careful what you select to eat ... that if you get there and it's clear the food is not meeting your expectations - that you immediately stop eating it rather than thinking it will get better. I did mention when paying the bill that it was good but not as good as last time. Given tho that I was sick when I got home ...I won't be returning till I see more reviews of improvement in food quality and consistency and far less if any more reports of people getting sick like I did.

REVIEW TEXT Smash Daddy’s is the food truck you don’t want to miss. I finally had the chance to check them out, and I can honestly say it was one of the best burgers I’ve had in a long time—crispy smash patties, melty cheese, fresh toppings, and a perfectly toasted bun that holds it all together.

Even better? The crew running the truck was fast, friendly, and clearly passionate about what they’re doing. You can tell they’re not just serving burgers—they’re building a following.

The fries were golden and crispy, and the overall vibe around the truck made it feel like more than just a quick bite. This is exactly the kind of local gem that makes food trucks exciting again. If you see Smash Daddy’s parked nearby, stop what you’re doing and get in line. Worth it every time.

REVIEW TEXT I genuinely enjoy this restaurant and typically have nothing but positive experiences—the food and atmosphere are usually great, which is why I felt conflicted even writing this.

Unfortunately, tonight was an exception. With the exception of my drink and my child’s meal, everything we ordered came out incorrectly. Our server didn’t write the order down and asked us multiple times what we wanted, yet the food was still wrong. We remained in good spirits and didn’t want to make a fuss at the time, but it was clear that the service tonight was lacking.

I’m sharing this not to complain, but because this place is generally wonderful and I’d hate for an experience like this to become the norm. I truly hope this was just an off night!

body.input: REVIEW TEXT I work downtown and our office eats lunch from here regularly, the food is good and the staff are friendly. However, I have a glaring complaint and that is Thai House needs to hire more servers. Each time we’re sat, everything takes longer than it does at other similar sized restaurants in the area and that is clearly due to the skeleton crew they’re working on. Today I placed an order for pick up, lunch combo, and I was told 15-20 minutes until it’s ready. I showed up 20 minutes after I placed the order and proceeded to sit in the waiting area, waiting for my food for another 25 minutes. It’s not fair to customers or to the staff. Thanks for reading, I do genuinely enjoy the food from here!

REVIEW TEXT Stopped by on a Thursday a few minutes past 11am when they open.  Interior is simple and clean – the only problem was that the front door opens directly into the dining area  which introduces cold air each time the door is open.  They do have room to have a double door at the entrance which would eliminate that problem.

Fairhaven Meatball Sandwich was tasty and quite filling although I would have preferred less bun.  The Fairhaven burger was good and juicy but the fries were a bit disappointing because they were not crispy.
The Carolina Gold Smoke Pork Grilled Cheese was very tasty and quite filling.
Overall, we were a bit disappointed since the fries did not meet our expectations and the food served was good but fell a bit short of expectations at the price charged.  After reading several past reviews, we thought the food served would have been exceptional instead of just average.  We won't be back.

body.input:
REVIEW TEXT We had such a wonderful experience dining here tonight! Our server, Dimitri, was fantastic - attentive, kind, and truly made us feel taken care of throughout the evening.

We started with the wedge salad and the loaded potato soup, and you could immediately tell everything was homemade. The flavors were fresh and comforting, and the timing between courses was perfect. It was clear the kitchen takes care to cook everything properly rather than rush it out.

For entrées, I ordered the pork porterhouse (well-done because I’m pregnant), and it still came out tender, juicy, and full of flavor. It had the perfect amount of heat! Amazing for me, though if you’re spice-sensitive, you may want to go a different path. The béarnaise sauce paired with the broccolini was beautifully made, and you could actually taste the tarragon, which is rare since it’s often overshadowed by excessive butter elsewhere.

My date ordered the filet special topped with crab, served with mashed potatoes and asparagus. He mentioned that while the crab was delicious, it made the dish very rich - and since filet is already a rich cut, it tipped it just a bit over the edge for his preference. He also initially thought the portion looked small, but ended up praising the chef for perfect portioning; he finished the meal feeling full and satisfied without being overly stuffed.

You can tell there’s a lot of love and passion behind every dish here - it truly comes through in every bite. The staff seemed genuinely happy to be there, the restaurant was very clean, and the overall atmosphere was perfect for our date night. We didn’t take photos because we wanted to just enjoy our time together, but we left knowing people needed to hear how worth it this place is. Highly recommend!

We also tried the Bill’s Bananas Foster for dessert and not only was it delicious, but the presentation made it feel extra special and memorable.

A special shoutout to our waiter, Dimitri, who provided excellent service and made our celebration even more enjoyable. He was attentive, friendly, and professional throughout the entire evening.

We’re already looking forward to coming back for happy hour to try more of their well-priced appetizers. Highly recommend!

body.input:
REVIEW TEXT While we were excited to try a new brewery, we were unfortunately underwhelmed. We tried 4 beers, all of which were very bitter. Like mouth coating bitter. While you expect that from an IPA, a basic Pale Ale should not be as bitter as the IPAs. The India Red Ale was weirdly sweet and tasted like extract was used. Just gives the beer a weird flavor. We go to breweries a lot and do know quite a bit about beer, so its not just that we ordered a type of beer we don’t like. I personally have never left a beer unfinished…here I did. The food was overpriced for both the portions and quality. We got a burger and a prime rib dip. The prime rib dip was more roll than meat and within that, about 40% grissle. It was also chewy and dry. The burger on the other hand was still red in the middle and was an unappealing texture due to that. I wish I’d taken pictures but I don’t usually review so I didn’t think to. The fries were great, so there’s that.

We left still hungry but not able to stomach anything else.

REVIEW TEXT My wife and I have been coming here for years, and we’ve always had a wonderful experience, whether in the bar, the restaurant, or out on the deck during the summer.

We will absolutely continue to make this one of our go-to spots all year round. Thank you again, Jessica, for making our anniversary so special and memorable. It was a fabulous experience we won’t forget!

REVIEW TEXT We got the prime rib and ribeye (both med rare). For the price, the steaks were okay, but the ribeye came with a sauce on top to make up for the taste of the actual meat.
We also got the chili lime shrimp appetizer and when I tell you this was the smallest appetizer I've ever seen.. I almost thought it was a joke, but the menu does, in fact, say it comes with FIVE 'prawns'. They were regular size shrimp that you eat in a single bite, not the larger prawns that you'd expect from a $15 for appetizer. The portion size was so laughable that we waited in weary apprehension for the $100 in steaks for the next 30 minutes.
Prime rib 3.8/5
Ribeye 3.5/5
The sauce for the chili lime shrimp was tasty, but we got more flavor from dipping our forks into the sauce than the 2.5 small shrimps we both ate within 10 seconds of it being dropped off.

body.input:
REVIEW TEXT I have never had an experience like this one. Ordered delivery and waited the 35 minutes to the estimated delivery time. Waited an extra 40 minutes past that and called the store to see what was going on and make sure I hadn't messed up and clicked pick-up. The person who talked with us on the phone said the order had not been picked up by the delivery driver. (Side note, if I had been aware they were not using their own delivery driver, I would not have chosen that option. They should make that known.) We told her we would come in and pick up since the timing would work at that point.

When we got to the store, the employee who "helped" took several minutes running around "trying to find" our order. It was clear she already realized the order was gone and was just getting another person to come out front with her. She looked the order up in the computer and hesitantly said "picked up by third party driver."

My dad and I were upset over this and asked why we had been told it was still there when it wasn't. The employee tried to backpedal and say she had called right back and tried to tell us...but seconds earlier she had been acting as though she had no clue what was going on and had to do a big show of looking it up? That doesn't make any sense. Neither employee was concerned about how late the delivery had been, just interested in providing excuses and trying to get rid of us.

Now I am back home to find ice cold pizza on the back porch. Waste of $54. Horrible customer service, gross lack of accountability amongst employees.

body.input:
REVIEW TEXT This place never disappoints. The food is absolutely delicious every time we come here. This time I ordered halibut with sweet potato waffle fries, my husband had the Reuben sandwich, and we started with a warm pretzel with dip as an appetizer, which we’ve now ordered for the second time. The pretzel was perfect, crispy on the outside and soft inside, and the dip was so good that I saved some to eat with my fries.

In the past, I’ve also tried the clam chowder, classic fish and chips, and the burgers, and everything has been consistently excellent. You can really tell the kitchen cares about quality.

The service is just as wonderful as the food, friendly, attentive, and welcoming. Clayton, who took care of us during our last visit, was incredibly positive, gave great recommendations, and clearly knows his job very well. He brought everything out quickly and made sure we had everything we needed. If the manager happens to see this review, Clayton definitely deserves a raise.

I especially remember coming here for my birthday last September. When I ordered cheesecake, the waitress put a candle in it to make my birthday feel special, which was such a thoughtful and kind gesture.

Definitely one of our favorite places to come back to. Highly recommended.

Wouldn’t go back.

REVIEW TEXT I recently enjoyed some fried Korean chicken and tteokbokki, and it was such a flavorful experience! Very authentic Korean fried chicken like the k-dramas!!
The fried Korean chicken was perfectly crispy on the outside and incredibly juicy on the inside. The sauce had that amazing balance. Every bite had the perfect crunch.
The tteokbokki was just as delicious. The rice cakes were soft and chewy, soaked in a rich, spicy gochujang sauce that had just the right kick. It was comforting, warm, and full of authentic flavor.
Together, they made the perfect combo—crispy, spicy, sweet, and satisfying. Definitely a meal I would crave again!

REVIEW TEXT Nov 2023: Great new spot in Anacortes! We had the salmon, fish & chips, roasted squash soup of the day and peanut butter chocolate cheesecake for dessert. Everything was perfectly cooked and super flavourful! Great service as well; we can’t wait to come back to try out their breakfast menu.

Dec 2023: came back for dinner again and tried the rock fish burger, kimchi veggie burger, halloumi burger & the cumin roasted carrots. Everything was delicious once again! The carrots are a must try, especially if you like goat cheese. I wouldn’t order the halloumi burger again as it was pretty salty with a lot of olives but my mom loved it. The kimchi burger has a great homemade vegan patty and the brioche bun was one of the best I’ve had. I also subbed the fries with it for the Greek salad which was huge and so good!!

Update Feb 2026: Finally tried their brunch and it was just as great! Best chicken and waffles EVER, the shakshuka was super flavourful, fish and chips were as perfect as ever and the biscuit was also fab.
